Document: # Rule 3.8 Silicons should follow their laws to the best of their ability. - Silicons are considered any entity whose actions are dictated by a mechanical lawset, such as cyborgs and AI. - Silicon roles should generally not violate their laws without explicit permission from an admin. Some exceptions to this rule may be given in extreme circumstances. - Be thoughtful about your actions; for example, letting someone into atmos could cause crew harm if they are not qualified to work in engineering. - The term 'crew'—frequently used silicon's lawsets—refers to any person who has an ID shown on your HUD. This applies unless it is explicitly stated otherwise by another law. - You may choose how to deal with law conflicts how you see fit, assuming you remain consistent with your approach. - Law priority is ordered from top to bottom in the law menu. This means that Law 0 takes precedent over Law 1 unless another law explicitly states otherwise.
